Segments to watch under the coming fire weather

Source: R/wind.R
forecast_watchlist.Rd

Flags forecast hours that meet the fire-weather criteria (fire_wind_hours() thresholds, normally the climatological ones) or fall inside an active Red Flag Warning, then reports per segment which strike trees those winds would throw into the line (wind_fall_exposure() geometry) and whether the segment's grown-in canopy is dry (canopy_dryness()), when present.

Usage

forecast_watchlist(
  risk,
  forecast,
  alerts = NULL,
  min_gust_ms = NULL,
  max_rh = NULL,
  spread_deg = NULL,
  bound = c("lo", "hi")
)

Arguments

risk

Output of wind_fall_exposure() (trees need bearing_deg and arc_*_deg).

forecast

Output of nws_forecast().

alerts

Output of nws_alerts(), or NULL.

min_gust_ms, max_rh

Fire-weather thresholds; default to those used for the climatology in attr(risk$segments, "wind").

spread_deg

Fall-direction allowance, as in wind_fall_exposure().

bound

"lo" or "hi": which conductor bound defines the strike trees and their arcs.

Value

A tibble, one row per segment with any flagged exposure, ordered by trees exposed: seg_id, first_hour, n_hours, max_gust_ms, min_rh_pct, n_trees_exposed, red_flag, dry_grow_in. Attribute hours holds the flagged forecast hours.
